podcast.title: One-Off Drummers Group for Live Earth (2007)
podcast.body: SOS All Stars was a unique, one-off group comprised of drummers Taylor Hawkins, Roger Taylor (Queen), and Chad Smith (Red Hot Chili Peppers), assembled specifically for the Live Earth show in London in 2007. This project highlighted a special gathering of influential rock drummers. "This was a one-off drummers group, but together for the live earth show in London in 2007."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: SOS All Stars (2007) - One-Off Drummer Supergroup
xref.body: Taylor Hawkins participated in SOS All Stars, a special one-off drummers' group formed for the Live Earth show in London in 2007. He was joined by Roger Taylor of Queen and Chad Smith of the Red Hot Chili Peppers, showcasing his connections within the drumming community. "In addition to the Coat Tale writers, there was SOS All Stars."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Member of SOS All Stars
xref.body: Roger Taylor joined Taylor Hawkins and Chad Smith in the one-off drummers' group SOS All Stars for the Live Earth show in London in 2007. This performance brought together influential drummers for a special event. "He was joined by Roger Taylor, of course, and Chad Smith of the Red Hot Chili Peppers."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
